name: storyarc
description: Monorepo tooling for StoryArc — native comic, manga and ebook readers for iOS and Android.

scripts.lint: pnpm tokens:check && pnpm spec:validate && pnpm tokens:verify && pnpm fixtures:check
scripts.test:ios:epub: cd apps/ios/Packages/StoryArcEpub && xcodebuild test -scheme StoryArcEpub -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -quiet
scripts.build:ios: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -quiet
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:ios && pnpm test:ios && pnpm lint:android && pnpm test:android
